texts.zh:
我们的合成化社会、先进的合成躯体和民意都指向了一条更保守的合成化路线。我们的人民可以保有定制的身体外形的同时，几乎任意地切换身体。

这可以让更有经验的官员暂时接管那些较为低效的同行，从而大幅度提高官僚效率。
texts.en:
Our synthesized society, improved synthetic bodies, and general sentiment all point towards a more conservative path for synthesization. While retaining a bespoke physical form, our people will be able to exchange bodies almost at will.

This will allow more experienced officials to temporarily assume control of their less effective counterparts, markedly improving bureaucratic performance.

texts.zh:
我们现在已经准备好在合成化革命中迈出明智的下一步，即拥抱完全虚拟化的存在。

临时躯体会负责执行现实世界的任务，但主要的人口均转变成一种更加非物质的存在形式。

这将使命令能够迅速有效地执行，并大大减少政府的监督。
texts.en:
We are now ready to take the next logical step in the synthesization revolution, the embrace of a fully virtual existence.

Temporary bodies will carry out tasks in the physical world, but the majority of the population is willing to transition to a more immaterial state of being.

This will enable orders to be carried out quickly and efficiently, and with the far less governmental oversight.

texts.zh:
我们社会的各个部门都已经适应了合成化的生活，但关于进一步特化的好处，从数据上仍然没有定论。

我们要创建身份后门，让监管官员接管无能下属的身体，还是要开发一种网络虚拟接口，从而无延迟地同步监督多个政府项目。
texts.en:
We have adapted all parts of society to synthetic life but data remains inconclusive on the benefits of further specialization.

We can either create identity backdoors which allow supervising officials to take over the bodies of ineffectual subordinates, or develop a networked virtual interface for them to oversee multiple government projects simultaneously without latency.

label.en: Allow officials to take over inefficient peers.
